g.text: Common envelope: entity · source mode · sequence/version/correlation · freshness · reason/impact/evidence · action/deep link · permission/masking · badge
LOADING: stale previous success is not current; bounded wait/cancel. EMPTY: neutral, not verified. ERROR: safe message, no raw stack/secret/path.
QUOTA: checkpoint + incomplete steps + reset + reconcile; never FAIL/PASS. CANCEL_REQUESTED receipt is separate from CANCELLED effective time.
RECONNECT: Last-Event-ID, gap/replay/order/dedupe and stale banner; no new Run. terminal Run reuse is forbidden.
PERMISSION_DENIED is independent from BLOCKED: required permission + actor role + masked resource + request access action.
PASS needs actual qualifying execution. FAIL/SKIPPED/BLOCKED/ERROR/NOT_EXECUTED/MOCK/FIXTURE/STATIC cannot be green or counted.
48 surfaces × 7 required states = 336 matrix cells. optimistic version + idempotency + server receipt + terminal immutability.
Static specimen only: actual browser, API, DB, Event, SSE, network and DIR remain NOT_EXECUTED.
